narrative.overview: The portfolio is a console, not a page. The visitor operates it: the interactive CLI hero is the front door, and every section below is a panel of that same system. This world deliberately refuses the decorated-portfolio default — no Persona 5 confetti, no floating shapes, no glow-everything. Restraint is the upgrade. The palette is a phosphor CRT in a dark room: a near-black green-tinted ground, one signal green that carries every interactive promise, and hairline borders that define panels without shouting. Depth comes from layered surfaces and a single soft ambient shadow, never colored halos. Motion is sparse and purposeful; the terminal boot sequence is the only performance that should feel alive.
keyCharacteristics: One accent color (signal green) carries all interactive signal; red is reserved for danger, yellow for the single WIP marker.
Hairline borders and layered panels instead of heavy cards or glow.
JetBrains Mono is the system voice; Outfit is the display/body voice.
The terminal boot sequence is the signature interaction; everything else recedes.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: Signal green is used on a minority of any given screen. Its rarity is what makes it mean 'you can act here.'

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Panels are separated by 1px hairlines, never by thick borders or colored glow.

rules.name: The Mono-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Interactive and system chrome speaks in JetBrains Mono; readable prose speaks in Outfit.

dos: Use signal green sparingly — only where the visitor can act.
Separate panels with 1px hairlines, not thick borders or glow.
Set interactive chrome in JetBrains Mono and prose in Outfit.
Keep the terminal the loudest element on the page; let sections recede.
Use the single ambient shadow for the terminal window and skills block, and keep cards flat.
donts: Don't reintroduce floating shapes, diagonal stripes, scanlines, or particle bursts.
Don't use colored glow shadows or hard offset (neobrutalist) shadows.
Don't add a light mode — the product is dark-only by commitment.
Don't set body copy in monospace.
Don't scatter hover animations across every element; the boot sequence is the one performance.
